name: Studio I: Interaction Design (IxD)
description: This course introduces students to the fundamentals of interaction design, focusing on principles such as affordances, feedback, constraints, and usability. Students practice user-centered methods including need finding, task flows, and persona creation, while learning ideation techniques and prototyping methods ranging from paper sketches to digital low-fidelity prototypes. Emphasis is placed on usability testing, iteration, and clear communication of design concepts through wireframes, storyboards, and simple interactive demos. The course outcomes leads to a final prototype and presentation, building a strong foundation for IxD Studio II in the following semester.
